title: LaRA: Layer-wise Representation Analysis for Detecting Data Contamination in RL Post-Training
authors_zh: Minju Gwak, Minseo Kwak, Dongseok Lee, Guijin Son, Alan Ritter, Jaehyung Kim
paper_type_zh: 污染、验证器、奖励或评测可靠性审计
best_for_zh: 需要审计 RL 推理模型污染风险的研究者。
one_line: Layer-wise metrics detect reward-driven memorization after RL post-training.
以受控扰动下的逐层表征几何，审计 RL 后训练中的奖励驱动记忆污染。
why: It separates contamination signals from output-level confidence changes after RL.
inclusion_reason: Layer-wise representation auditing for contamination signals after RL post-training.

title: Problem
问题
html: Output likelihood and entropy can change after RL post-training for reasons unrelated to memorization: reward shaping, decoding, and policy collapse all confound them. The paper asks whether contamination can instead be detected from how internal representations react to controlled semantic perturbations.
RL 后训练后，输出似然和熵的变化未必来自记忆污染：奖励塑形、解码策略和策略塌缩都可能造成混淆。论文转而检验，能否通过受控语义扰动下内部表征的反应识别污染。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: LaRA frames RL-post-training contamination as instance-level membership inference. For a target math problem, it builds structurally matched numerical variants, masks the same kind of key information, and makes blank-preserving paraphrases. Across all layers it measures target-relative shift magnitude (RSM), perturbation-direction alignment (DC), and local paraphrase variability (RSI), robustly standardizes them against clean examples, reverses RSI’s sign, and averages them into SLaRA. It is an audit protocol, not a training dataset.
LaRA 将 RL 后训练污染视为样本级成员推断：对目标数学题构造同结构的数值变体，遮去同类关键信息，再生成保留空位的改写。它在全部层上测量相对位移幅度 RSM、扰动方向对齐 DC、局部改写变异 RSI，以干净样本作稳健标准化，将 RSI 反向后跨层平均为 SLaRA。它是审计协议，不是训练数据集。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Construct semantically controlled perturbations of evaluation inputs and collect hidden activations from every layer.
  1. Measure Representation Shift Magnitude (RSM) between original and perturbed activations.
  1. Measure Directional Collapse (DC) and Representation Stability Index (RSI) to capture geometric concentration and robustness.
  1. Aggregate layer-wise metrics and compare their contamination-detection performance with output-level likelihood or entropy baselines. The paper is listed as AI4GOOD Workshop 2026 and arXiv:2605.29888.

1. 构造语义受控的输入扰动，并采集各层隐藏激活。
  1. 计算原输入与扰动输入间的表征位移幅度（RSM）。
  1. 计算方向塌缩（DC）和表征稳定性指数（RSI），刻画几何集中与稳健性。
  1. 跨层聚合指标，并同输出似然或熵等基线比较污染检测效果。论文列为 AI4GOOD Workshop 2026，arXiv:2605.29888。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Each model is tested with 30 known RL-training members and 30 AIME 2026 non-members. On the initial LIMR checkpoint, SLaRA reaches AUC 0.80 and TPR@5% FPR 0.46; its best output baseline PPL is 0.73 and 0.13. On Eurus, SC+SLaRA is strongest at initialization (0.73, 0.31) and reaches (0.79, 0.38) after two further epochs. DC is the strongest single metric, but the three-metric aggregate is more stable across stages.
每个模型以 30 条已知 RL 训练成员和 30 条 AIME 2026 非成员测试。初始 LIMR 上，SLaRA 的 AUC 为 0.80、TPR@5% FPR 为 0.46；最佳输出基线 PPL 为 0.73、0.13。Eurus 初始时 SC+SLaRA 为 0.73、0.31，继续训练两轮后为 0.79、0.38。DC 是最强单项，但三项聚合跨训练阶段更稳定。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The contribution is an explicitly layer-wise, perturbation-based audit for RL contamination. RSM, DC, and RSI distinguish shift magnitude, directionality, and stability instead of collapsing the question into one output-confidence number.
贡献在于提出面向 RL 污染的逐层、扰动式审计。RSM、DC 与 RSI 分别保留位移大小、方向性和稳定性，不把问题压缩为单一输出置信度。

title: Limitations
局限
html: LaRA requires controlled perturbations and access to hidden states across layers, creating computational and deployment overhead. Its signals may also depend on model architecture, layer alignment, perturbation quality, and the particular RL setup; a geometric anomaly alone does not identify the contaminated source.
LaRA 需要受控扰动和各层隐藏状态，带来计算及部署开销。其信号也可能依赖模型架构、层间对齐、扰动质量和具体 RL 设置；几何异常本身不能定位污染来源。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use it as a pre-release audit for RL-trained reasoning models: retain perturbation seeds, hidden-state extraction settings, per-layer metrics, and a clean comparison population. Escalate suspicious cases to data-lineage and behavioral checks rather than treating the detector as proof of exposure.
可把它作为 RL 推理模型发布前审计：保存扰动种子、隐藏状态提取设置、逐层指标和干净对照群体。对可疑个案还应追查数据谱系与行为证据，不能把检测器当作接触污染的证明。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Interpret gains against the exact perturbation construction and output baselines. The important question is whether a metric separates memorization from reward-induced representation change, not merely whether it differs between two model checkpoints.
解读增益时应对照确切的扰动构造和输出基线。关键不是两个检查点是否有差异，而是该指标能否将记忆污染同奖励诱导的表征变化区分开。
